da-false-claim.evidence: The text claims 'The six basis operators generate the discrete group $S_3 \cong \mathrm{Dih}_3$'. This is mathematically false. For $q \neq 1$, the Hecke algebra basis elements do not form a finite group under multiplication (e.g. $\sigma_0^2 = (q - q^{-1})\sigma_0 + 1$). They form a 6-dimensional vector space basis for the algebra, but do not close as a group.
